claims.statement: Schema ownership is explicit: Alembic writes DDL and SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM models mirror the tables for queries; models never autogenerate migrations, and the 0001 baseline is hand-written and replaced the Supabase schema at the big-bang cutover.

The latest migration head on main is 0053_single_page_external_source_sync_state (revisions 0001..0053); the merge migration 091e7edc9f76 resolves a parallel-heads situation during the password-reset OTP work, and make release-check asserts exactly one alembic head before any deploy.

The baseline schema runs on self-hosted PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector with HNSW vector indexes, own users + JWT, BOT/HUMAN/CLOSED modes, and ports the bus-timetable SQL functions and match_memories/match_documents RAG functions verbatim from Supabase; a documents VIEW shims the old documents table over knowledge_documents/knowledge_chunks.

EMBEDDING_DIM = 3072 is a schema-pinned code constant; knowledge_chunks.embedding is vector(3072) and the ANN candidate index is halfvec(3072) HNSW (migration 0014); migration 0016 mirrors the halfvec HNSW fix on memories.embedding.

Operational decisions are encoded in named migrations: 0041 typed authority scopes, 0042 installation revision lifecycle, 0045 runtime authority stamps on bot_runs, 0047 channel_accounts + uq_channel_accounts_one_active_facebook_messenger, 0050 data ingestion recovery, 0051 bot_runs.decision_trace JSONB, 0052 external source sync state, 0053 single-page external source sync state.

integration_settings stores credentials encrypted at rest: AES-GCM v1: ciphertext for global secrets, v2: ciphertext for per-Page Facebook tokens with AAD = page_id so a row moved between Pages fails to decrypt (InvalidTag).

record_audit inserts an AuditEvent and flushes without committing so callers compose audit rows with other writes; audit_events payload stores changed keys (never secret values); installation_manifest_revisions is referenced by bot_runs.runtime_revision_id with FK RESTRICT so authority rows cannot be deleted while bot runs reference them.

scripts/seed_dev.py is idempotent and refuses to run outside app_env=="development"; scripts/create_admin.py uses the sync database URL and hash_password_sync (the sync argon2 helper) so scripts never accidentally block the event loop, with --only-if-no-admins as a deploy bootstrap guard.
